{{Quote|For the duration of this mission, I'm a ''wealthy merchant''&mdash;hence the ''1,000 credit coin'' at the ready&mdash;and you're my ''servant''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Suited">{{TCWComicCite|6.10|Suited}}</ref>}}
A '''credit coin''' was a type of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]] currency. They were issued in denominations of .1, .2, .5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1,000, 2,000, and 5,000. Larger denominations existed but were rarely circulated.
